subject: skill:use-garden
gist: Trigger rows widened and loosened by mode within the reading budget
reason: The 0.2.0 series loaded few starts and habits; the skill's invocation cases widen as trigger rows loosened by mode within the reading budget, which status reads for the skills a change owes. No page changes.

authorisedBy.words: The operator's words of 2026-11-05, "I saw the linear run inspect and realised very less skills were invoked and I have a feeling that more could have been selected and used; we need widening of invocation cases and make it a bit loose", and "okay then please lock on both these jobs": every start and habit carries its invocation cases as trigger rows, loosened by mode within the mode's reading budget, its description naming the same cases

ruling.words: The method items carry the old chain's native entries use-garden-2026-09-26, under the operator's rulings of 2026-09-22 that garden is consulted when relevant without a per-lookup question and that one optional skill owns the instructions, and use-garden-answers-2026-09-28, under the operator's ruling of 2026-09-28 that a request for a recommendation consults under a minimal recorded request

the operator's rulings of 2026-10-04, "cool then lock everything in": every change in every mode has one record its steps write, which replaced the tickets' execution accounts, and a habit writes none of its own, the installed ledger guide saying a consultation that serves a change runs with --change and a question's names no change
J-59, on the operator's words of 2026-10-09 ('okay then implement all of this'): a gist of at most twelve words on every account whose reason is stated; no text, measure or method changes

The operator's words of 2026-10-18 on the redesign (N-56, items 2 and 7), "we need the upstream prose upfront and references hold how to work meaning the artefacts etc" and, on the ingest procedures, "we wanna have there prose .. what we don't wanna have is there artefact system and fit them to use ours"; and J-93 S2's finalise words of 2026-10-19, "Fast route, merged slices, parallel jobs (Recommended)": a skill's front is the upstream prose its recipe cuts, and its mechanics, where its work lands, its section's form, its depths at each mode and its commands, stand on its references page
The operator's card of 2026-10-19 naming the three modes, "quick, regular, careful (Recommended)": the old names and the trial step in a skill's prose are corrected by the smallest substitution

The operator's words of 2026-10-28 on the keeper of a prose method, "ingestion of prose skills from upstream kind of needs a thinking in direction of a cli based keeper, holder kind of architecture which makes sure the prose worked", with the card "Draft J-153 now, with the roster audit" and the card "Adopt the four-part test with the cost classes and the caps": a feature of greenline is prose plus its keeper, and each skill's recipe lists the promises its pages state, each with the fact, hold, record or oracle that keeps it, or its gap marked by the keeper test (J-153 S4)
